problem_type: Projection consumers bypass shared film parameter scope
symptom: check:storyboard-owner rejects ShotSpec migration and row outputs; inherited film defaults disappear from derived metadata.
direct_cause: Migration and row video output read raw shot parameters; row image output omits resolved parameters entirely. Reader wrappers do not pass the plan.
class_root: Every parameter projection must carry its owning plan through the existing scope resolvers instead of treating a shot as the entire scope.
affected_population: Row images, keyframes and reused row videos
internal_only_reason: The invariant and failing fixtures concern application-owned plan scope and pure projection, not vendor behavior.
invariants: Film defaults and explicit shot overrides use resolveShotParams; paired keyframes use resolveKeyframeParams.
Image shot settings do not overwrite independently configured video outputs.
Inputs remain immutable and stale applied parameters are removed on reuse.

door_reduction.why_not: Generated post-fix map adds three resolver consumer edges, not independent owners. Batch/read wrappers, node creation, node projection and strategy consumers retain their separate roles while delegating all parameter decisions to the existing scope owner.

generality_proof: Both ShotSpec wrappers carry the complete plan; both image/video row output paths resolve the persisted plan snapshot. No consumer recreates the inheritance algorithm or enumerates film keys.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Delegate strategy parameter projection to the existing plan-aware scope owner.
Own film-default and explicit shot parameter precedence.
Resolve scope before creating or reusing a row image.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Door-map found the wrapper's direct migration call; focused reader regression verifies plan defaults survive.
Focused tests cover inheritance, explicit overrides, stale removal and independent image-to-video settings.
Existing projection already selects the shared shot/keyframe resolvers.

recurrence.reason: New consumers can repeat raw parameter projection whenever a plan owns defaults.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs planShotToShotSpec migrateStoryboardPlanShots ensureStoryboardRowImageOutput ensureStoryboardRowVideoOutput resolveShotParams resolveKeyframeParams (2956 production files, 11 doors before repair)
rg resolveShotParams/resolveKeyframeParams across projection, strategy and migration; inspected the reader wrapper one hop beyond migration.

prevention.invariant: Plan-aware projection delegates scope to the existing shared resolvers.
prevention.failure_mode: Missing legacy plan context supplies only the current shot, without inventing defaults. Explicit malformed snapshots fail parsing rather than silently rewriting saved intent.
prevention.strategy: Remove raw reads, thread plan context through both wrappers, and resolve each output role before metadata projection.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove direct raw parameter reads, not existing user content or output functionality. Legacy shot-only calls keep their signature.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No external package owns the application scope invariant.

migration: Read-time projection only; no persisted project migration or media generation.
residual_risks: UI, real generation and Windows execution are unverified; explicitly outside this line's allowed validation.
